title: Direct electrodeposition of lithium titanate as a lithium-ion battery anode active material in propylene carbonate solution containing titanyl compounds
content:

Lithium titanium oxide (LTO) anode materials for lithium-ion (Li-ion) batteries have become an alternative to the typically used graphitic-based materials as anode materials due to their better safety performance and longer life cycles.
